I was a senior at the University of Vermont and she was in her first year at a near by college. When we met, she was holding a banner demanding that the University cut ties with the pesticide giant, Monsanto. I knew that I had to join her. But how could I have known that my life would change forever? Since that day, we've been through 15 birthdays, a decade of marriage, putting down roots in Eugene, law school, grad school, the births of our daughter and our son, and so much more. Through it all, her passion, clear sense of purpose, and power shines through as she has taken on the righteous fights. When Doyle told me late last year that she was called to consider another run for Congress, I knew that the feedback from supporters like you would make all the difference in her decision. That's why I am asking you to help me meet Doyle's 42nd birthday fundraising goal of $4,200 for her. body:
| | | Team, **Earlier this week, I tested positive for COVID-19.** At that point, I’d been sick for three days – fever, chills, shortness of breath, no appetite – but initially had a negative result from a take-home test. **The good news is that I'm starting to feel better now.** I’ll be open with you: I have asthma, high blood pressure, and a history of blood clots. The outcome from this could have been way worse. I believe that the vaccine saved my life. **Please, please get vaccinated and take this wave driven by the Omicron variant seriously. For your own sake — as well as those in your life who are most vulnerable.** But the fact of the matter is it _shouldn’t_ entirely come down to the responsibility of the individual. Public health is just that: public. It shouldn’t require standing through the pain in a line for two hours in the cold to receive a PCR test. At this stage, high-quality masks should be widely available to everyone. And we desperately need to fix the longstanding structural failures of our healthcare system that lead so many people to avoid care in fear of crippling medical debt. Let’s be clear: we need our leaders to step up. If there’s one thing to learn from the experience of living through this pandemic, it is that we are all in this together. It’s long past time for us to build a society together based on that fact. Stay safe and healthy, With love, Mckayla | [ DONATE

Friend,

That's me you're looking at.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40691166/325487654/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1893-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMDRmMDUwYy03MTc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0S4Q54n8Mhle1FEwL-p438nLQRavUWA3y5ZimZ0FgiI=)I grew up poor in the segregated South, the daughter of a maid and a janitor. If you had told me back then, as a young Black girl, that I would become the first in my family to graduate college, the first woman to lead the Orlando Police Department, a congresswoman and a candidate for the U.S. Senate, well – I just don't know if I would have believed you. What I _did_ believe then – and what I carry deep in my soul to this day – is the lesson of my hardworking parents to "never tire of doing good."
It was my parents' words that inspired me to get into public service. It was their words that have driven me to do good every chance I get. From my time as a young social worker to my career as a law enforcement officer to being representative of my community in Congress – "never tire" is a mantra that I've held dear.
My unlikely story of opportunity is proof of what is possible and what should be possible for every American. **As Florida's next U.S. senator, I will _never tire_ in the work to make sure the greatness of America is accessible and affordable for all Americans. **I will _never tire_ in continuing to do more good for you and your family.
But when it comes to this race, the GOP won't tire either: The Republican National Committee chair is already attacking me personally, while Mitch McConnell and GOP outside groups are ready to dump tens of MILLIONS into Florida to defeat me.

This is already shaping up to be the most expensive Senate election _ever –_ and with Florida's last Senate race being decided by a narrow .12% margin, every dollar we raise will count tremendously. **I know a thing or two about winning tough races, but I need your help because I can't do this alone.**
**[I'm depending on your grassroots support to power this historic campaign and help me fight back against the GOP's attacks – and right now, I'm falling short of my midnight goal. Then, on Thursday morning, the House passed H.R. 5746, which is now called the Freedom to Vote: John R. ## **❄️ WE GLOVE THIS TIME OF YEAR! ❄️**
#### 🎶 Don’t know about you, but we’re feeling ‘22! 🎶
Keep up the momentum on all of your New Years’ resolutions with some amazing trainings this upcoming week!

* * *

[**Identifying Strong Candidates for Political Office**](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1ORFRDJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTAxMTQyMl9UTERSJl9fcz1vNGJtdWFxam9sYzNxaGRxdmlzeSJ9.Clb65rAaWr0CdvvduCjEbIfPPp3RWX5wwnHUdSB1i-Q)
**Wednesday, January 19 at 1pm ET.** Do you think someone you know would make a great candidate? Join us for this training to identify folks in your community who would be great leaders!

During this training, our experts will focus on reviewing effective methods for finding strong candidates, recognizing common traits of strong candidates for political office, and the timeframe needed for recruitment.
| [RSVP NOW →](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1ORFRDJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTAxMTQyMl9UTERSJl9fcz1vNGJtdWFxam9sYzNxaGRxdmlzeSJ9.Clb65rAaWr0CdvvduCjEbIfPPp3RWX5wwnHUdSB1i-Q)
---

* * *

[**Candidate Recruitment Q &A with A’shanti F. Gholar**](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..dShusXAZXoVOqScwfvTDKUr9UJLfc4arcAsPhBHeIMI)
**Thursday, January 20 at 1pm ET.**
Democrats across the country can’t win a race unless they run! Identifying and recruiting candidates is an important part of building long-term power for the Democratic Party.

Join NDTC Founder and CEO Kelly Dietrich and special guest A’shanti F. Gholar, President of Emerge, on Thursday as they discuss finding and recruiting strong candidates to run. Oh, and don’t forget to bring any _burning_ questions you might have!

[RSVP NOW →](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..dShusXAZXoVOqScwfvTDKUr9UJLfc4arcAsPhBHeIMI)
---

* * *

[**Recruiting Candidates for Political Office**](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..sbmMQqfrU2HKF7f16zwIb3czIe_axfOn-0BOIdQLgJQ)
**Thursday, January 20 at 7pm ET.**
They say there is an art to persuasion - and you can use it to recruit candidates!

In this training, you’ll explore strategies for persuading folks to run for office, go over the many positive aspects of running, and naming systems of support for those you hope to recruit!

[RSVP NOW →](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..sbmMQqfrU2HKF7f16zwIb3czIe_axfOn-0BOIdQLgJQ)
---

* * *

[**Building a Candidate Support Plan**](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..WVmIprSDLQ8v2ZCvlLBfde_CUR8vIRMSqT9cH62X9V8)
**Friday, January 21 at 1pm ET.**
A plan is the first step to any aspect of campaigning. And we’re here to help you create and refine your Candidate Support Plan!

On Friday, learn the benefits of having a Candidate Support Plan, name the components of a Candidate Support Plan, and explain the practices for using this plan with a candidate.

[RSVP NOW →](https://t.dripemail2.com/c/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..WVmIprSDLQ8v2ZCvlLBfde_CUR8vIRMSqT9cH62X9V8)

| | | Dear Peter,

Our right to vote is the backbone of our democracy!

Once the integrity of our elections is threatened, we Americans will go the way of Venezuela and other socialist countries.

Currently Biden, with Sean Casten's and Marie Newman's full support, is pushing legislation that will dilute our voting system - and take away our rights. They are pushing to take away safeguards built into the system to protect voter security and put power over elections with the Federal Government.

On top of that - since the Democrats don't have support for this bill in the Senate, they want to change the governing rules to make it easier for them to take control.

This is outrageous! Those safeguards are in place for a reason!

When I am in Congress, I will fight to keep the power with the people. I will push election laws that protect our elections against corruption. I will fight for cleaning voter rolls, requiring photo IDs, and expanding training for election judges and poll watchers.

If you want your US Congressional Representative to fight for you and your rights, vote Conforti for Congress 2022!
[Click here](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=dba8203c46&e=25f4fa3311) to donate to my campaign and protect our rights and freedoms.
---
| Thank you,

Niki Conforti
Candidate

Voting is a sacred right and the filibuster is an outdated rule. **To uphold our democracy, we must _always_ protect rights before rules.** President Biden agrees — earlier this week, he spoke out in support of changing the Senate rules so we can act with urgency and pass the _Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act_. I’ve been a vocal supporter of abolishing the filibuster for a while now. It’s more important than ever that we finally eliminate Republicans’ tool of obstruction and protect the right to vote. [**Join me in calling on my colleagues in the Senate to change the filibuster rules and support the _Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act_. Senate Democrats earned 45 million more votes than Senate Republicans. Yet Republicans are abusing the filibuster to block voting rights legislation that most Senators support.**All so Republicans can keep up their rampant voter suppression efforts in the states.**
Republican-controlled legislatures in at least 19 states passed 34 laws to limit the right to vote last year. Make no mistake: **This is a direct attempt to override the will of the American people.**
The _Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act_ will protect and expand the right to vote so that every American has the opportunity to make their voice heard in our safe and free election process.

## [**Maya Angelou Is Featured on the Most Recently Minted U.S. Quarter**](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=cbcd89248c&e=42a933bda9)

---
| It was announced by the United States Mint that writer, performer, and social activist, Maya Angelou would be featured on the first quarter of the American Women Quarters program, which is set to debut new quarters between the 2022 and 2025. According to the U.S. Mint website, Angelou is pictured on the reverse side of the coin with her arms uplifted, and pictured behind her are a bird in flight and a rising sun. These images are said to be inspired by both her poetry and the way in which she carried herself and lived.

## [**Wisconsin Covid-19 Hospitalization Record Surpassed Again**](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=02b86ad457&e=42a933bda9)
---
| [ ](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=57b25f741b&e=42a933bda9)
---
| This Wednesday, January 12th Wisconsin hospitals reached their highest number of patients being treated for Covid-19 according to the Wisconsin Hospital Association. 2,278 Wisconsinites were being treated in hospitals across the state for the virus, which only surpassed the previous peak by one case which was recorded in November 2020. Dr. Ben Weston, Milwaukee’s chief health adviser noted that many of these hospitalizations consisted of at risk individuals which include young children, older people, and those with compromised immune systems. This high number of hospitalizations makes it difficult for others to get hospital care and ICU beds continue to remain in short supply across the state, and it was noted that western Wisconsin currently has zero ICU beds available. It is encouraged for people who are able to receive the Covid-19 Vaccination, including the booster shot, as it is the best tool to prevent infection and furthermore serious illness and hospitalization due to Covid-19.
---
|
---
|
## [**Bill to be Introduced to Keep Congressional Lawmakers From Holding or Trading Stocks**](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=0a7513074c&e=42a933bda9)
---
| [ ](https://jessicaforwis.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c27543103b71c2381252057eb&id=289f66da1a&e=42a933bda9)
---
| Georgia senator Jon Ossoff is set to introduce a bill to keep members of Congress from holding or trading individual stocks while they are in office. The bill is also to include that legislators also place their financial assets in blind trusts just as Ossoff did when he was elected just a year ago. This bill would be in opposition to House Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s stance on the issue of stock trading bans for members at a press conference. She stated “We are a free-market economy. They should be able to participate in that” when questioned regarding the issue.Other democrats such as Elizabeth Warren and Alexandria Ocasio-Cotez continue to stick by their endorsement of stock-trading bans.
---

clean_body: Your weekly dose of news from Team Katzenmeyer. | | | | | | | | Hello! Here's your weekly roundup of important stories you may have missed both locally and nationally! | | | | It was announced by the United States Mint that writer, performer, and social activist, Maya Angelou would be featured on the first quarter of the American Women Quarters program, which is set to debut new quarters between the 2022 and 2025. According to the U.S. Mint website, Angelou is pictured on the reverse side of the coin with her arms uplifted, and pictured behind her are a bird in flight and a rising sun. These images are said to be inspired by both her poetry and the way in which she carried herself and lived. | | | | This Wednesday, January 12th Wisconsin hospitals reached their highest number of patients being treated for Covid-19 according to the Wisconsin Hospital Association. 2,278 Wisconsinites were being treated in hospitals across the state for the virus, which only surpassed the previous peak by one case which was recorded in November 2020. Dr. Ben Weston, Milwaukee’s chief health adviser noted that many of these hospitalizations consisted of at risk individuals which include young children, older people, and those with compromised immune systems. This high number of hospitalizations makes it difficult for others to get hospital care and ICU beds continue to remain in short supply across the state, and it was noted that western Wisconsin currently has zero ICU beds available. It is encouraged for people who are able to receive the Covid-19 Vaccination, including the booster shot, as it is the best tool to prevent infection and furthermore serious illness and hospitalization due to Covid-19. | | | | Georgia senator Jon Ossoff is set to introduce a bill to keep members of Congress from holding or trading individual stocks while they are in office. The bill is also to include that legislators also place their financial assets in blind trusts just as Ossoff did when he was elected just a year ago. This bill would be in opposition to House Speaker Nancy Pelosi’s stance on the issue of stock trading bans for members at a press conference. She stated “We are a free-market economy. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Members of Congress are able to make huge profits from buying stocks that
they know will perform well based on pending legislation and private
briefings. Yet, Speaker Nancy Pelosi doesn’t see a problem with that.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88965?refcode=em20220114-21476&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=21476%2E1203867%2E1gDtHD ]Insider headline reads Pelosi rejects stock-trading ban for members of
Congress: 'We are a free market economy. They should be able to
participate in that.

This is unacceptable. Members of Congress buying stocks is what allowed
Republicans to use private COVID briefings to profit from stock purchases
in February 2020, before the public even knew a pandemic was about to hit.
Members of Congress buy stock in companies, including fossil fuel
companies, as they consider legislation that will directly benefit those
companies.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88965?refcode=em20220114-21476&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=21476%2E1203867%2E1gDtHD ]Sludge headline reads At least 100 House Members are Invested in Fossil
Fuels.

Stock trades will continue to fuel policies that profit big corporations
AND Members of Congress, but NOT benefit the people.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88965?refcode=em20220114-21476&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=21476%2E1203867%2E1gDtHD ]Peter, can
you help us fight to advocate for a stock trading ban in Congress and
elect more Representatives who won’t use their position for profit? Donate
$3 right now so we can fight back and change the status quo
in the political establishment.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88965?refcode=em20220114-21476&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=21476%2E1203867%2E1gDtHD ]Contribute

Justice Democrats like Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez spoke out when Speaker
Pelosi rejected the stock trading ban. There’s growing outcry over each
instance of a wealthy member of Congress, like Pelosi, dropping a lot of
money on a company’s stocks that their corporate-friendly policies will
help.

If we’re going to change Washington, and implement a ban on Members of
Congress trading stocks, then we need to change who is in Congress. We’re
doing that by working hard to protect our incumbent Justice Democrats and
elect 6 new Justice Democrats this year. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88965?refcode=em20220114-21476&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=21476%2E1203867%2E1gDtHD ]If you’re ready to upend the
status quo and transform the Democratic Party, chip in $3
to Justice Democrats right now.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1025&akid=21476%2E1203867%2E1gDtHD ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1026&akid=21476%2E1203867%2E1gDtHD ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

#

Friend,
Yesterday, I worked with my House Democratic colleagues to pass the _Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act_ — legislation to protect our constitutional right to vote and save our democracy.
I’m proud to have authored key provisions of this legislation, including my bill, the _Right to Vote Act,_ which will codify the right to vote in this country and prevent states from enacting voting restrictions without evidence. _The Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act_ also includes critical text from another bill I introduced, the _Inclusive Elections Act_ , which will restore Section 2 of the _Voting Rights Act_ and allow Black and brown citizens to fully participate in the electoral process.
Now that we in the House have done our job, I’m calling on my Senate colleagues to act urgently to reform the filibuster and get this bill passed. name: Emily  Burns
subject: Final reminder: for an Evening with Jodi Shaw (free) TONIGHT. We've got about 40 people, room for ~10 more.
body:
Hi, there,

Just a quick reminder about this event, which is TONIGHT, January 14th, at 7:00 pm, in Newton. The perfect event to fill in the spot of that dinner you were supposed to have but got canceled because everyone has COVID, but you’ve already recovered.

Details, again....

Thank you for your continued support and engagement with my campaign. One of the wonderful things about campaigning has been the incredible people I have met, in and out of the district. Jodi Shaw is one of the more interesting people, and is coming to my home tomorrow to speak about her experiences. She is colloquially known as the "[Smith College Whistleblower.](https://bariweiss.substack.com/p/whistleblower-at-smith-college-resigns)" Basically, she was at the intersection of what happens when social justice goes awry, and she spoke up about it--at great personal cost. I am very honored to have her at my home in Newton, and she will be speaking about the similarities with the shutdown of debate that has occurred with social justice excesses, as well as with COVID policy. She is not a Republican (I doubt she now has a party). This is an event about the conversations that we're not having (which, as I have been saying all along, is one of my chief reasons for running).

**Register here:**
[https://www.eventbrite.com/e/an-evening-with-jodi-shaw-tickets-244572582177](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/an-evening-with-jodi-shaw-tickets-244572582177)

If you are able to come, it would be lovely to see you. Just pizza, beer and wine for refreshments. If you don’t have childcare, but have kids old enough to hang out with other kids by themselves, feel free to bring them. We’ll have a big kids movie upstairs, and a little kids movie downstairs, so adults can converse on the main floor.

[https://www.eventbrite.com/e/an-evening-with-jodi-shaw-tickets-244572582177](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/an-evening-with-jodi-shaw-tickets-244572582177)

Hope all's well, stay warm this weekend, if I don't see you!

Sincerely,

Emily

P.S. feel free to invite others (including spouses, of course), but please don't post the message on social media, as it has our address. This is all via personal invite. Should be about 50 people--don't come if you're sick. My sense is everyone already got sick :)

He highlighted the new threat posed today by voter suppression and election subversion: "It's no longer about who gets to vote; it's about making it harder to vote. It’s about who gets to count the vote and whether your vote counts at all." As I've said for some time, we can't afford to lose our democracy because of arcane Senate rules that, as applied now, depart from the original intent of majority rule. That's why I'm continuing to fight to secure our elections and find a path to end or amend the rule that allows 41 of the 100 senators to permanently block the will of the majority of the American people. clean_body: | | Friends, Earlier this week President Biden called on the U.S. Senate to take bold action to protect the integrity of our elections. That's why I'm continuing to fight to secure our elections and find a path to end or amend the rule that allows 41 of the 100 senators to permanently block the will of the majority of the American people. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Let’s remember that not a single Republican senator — NOT ONE — supports the Freedom to Vote Act. In these midterm elections we need to protect all the Senate Democratic seats that are up this year — including right here in Maryland AND work to pick-up senate seats in states like Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Florida, Ohio and North Carolina. Team, **Yesterday, PA-01’s Representative Brian Fitzpatrick voted NO on legislation — the Freedom to Vote Act and John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act — to expand and protect voting rights.** The right to vote shouldn’t be a partisan issue in this country, but Fitzpatrick and his fellow Republicans — who uniformly voted against these bills — have made it so. The GOP has long attacked the right to vote, but have ramped up their attacks in recent years, especially after the historic turnout we saw in the 2020 election. In state legislatures like here in Pennsylvania, they’ve introduced thousands of bills to weaken our right to vote by passing voter ID laws, purging voter rolls, and banning or rolling back same-day voter registration, vote-by-mail, and ballot drop-boxes. _And Fitzpatrick just gave them a pass to keep doing it._ Our democracy as we know it is at stake, team, and Republicans have proved they’re willing to do anything to keep and amass power. **That’s why it’s CRITICAL we protect and expand our Democratic majorities in the House and Senate this November, and that includes flipping this seat from red to blue.** **[Unlike Brian Fitzpatrick, I will always stand up and fight for your sacred right to vote. name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Joe Biden's clarion call to change the filibuster to protect voting rights
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
need your response
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=%2FAfRfHIaW%2BdkmbczXxP7VNLV9MQNgL%2F2&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
This week, President Biden endorsed what I and this grassroots team have been urging for _months_ : reforming the filibuster to pass voting rights legislation.
In the wake of a widespread, coordinated, GOP-led assault on voting rights, this endorsement from the President couldn't be more urgent. Republicans have already introduced more than 440 voter suppression bills and passed dozens into law - shutting out millions of lawful voters from the polls in states like Georgia, Florida, and Texas.
The pathway before us is clear: Pass federal legislation that protects every American's right to vote, or uphold an arcane Senate rule while Republicans ramp up voter suppression.
I've made my choice, Friend. The Senate - once the world's greatest deliberative body - is broken. The Republican Party has consolidated around stalling tactic after stalling tactic, including the filibuster, to obstruct the will of the majority. When we can't even pass legislation that protects an individual's constitutional right to vote, then something bold must be done.
But here's the thing. Some of my Senate colleagues are still uncommitted to reforming the filibuster to pass voting rights legislation. After the President's new clarion call, we're closer than ever to making it happen, but it's going to take grassroots action like never before from this team and from you, Friend.
[**If you believe the Senate should change the filibuster to protect voting rights, I 'm asking you to click here and add your thoughts right now. I'm counting on 10,000 Democrats to speak out at this urgent moment before 11:59 p.m. tonight.**](https://surveys.signforgood.com/Biden-voting-rights?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1126-su-nd)
We can make this happen. Thank you for doing your part.
Dick

name: Derek Kilmer
subject: My friend and colleague Colin Allred
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
Peter,

Last year, Texas passed a voter suppression law with sweeping restrictions that make it more difficult to vote. SB1 prohibits extending early voting hours and drive-thru voting, enables partisan poll watchers, and bans mail-in ballot applications from being sent.

My friend and colleague, Congressman Colin Allred, represents the people of Texas's 32nd District, and he's always fought to preserve voting rights - first as a voting rights attorney and now as a congressman.

Colin fought alongside me in Congress to protect voting rights by passing the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act. And this week, he joined me in helping pass the Freedom to Vote: John R. Lewis Act through the House. Colin's also been instrumental in the fight to root out corruption in our government by voting to pass the Protecting Our Democracy Act.

Colin works tirelessly for the people of Texas's 32nd District, but he's facing a tough re-election campaign. The National Republican Congressional Committee has listed him as one of their top targets in the upcoming midterm elections.

[**Will you split a donation between my campaign and my colleague Congressman Colin Allred before our mid-month deadline to help defend the Democratic House majority? We need to work together to defend leaders like Colin.**](https://act.myngp.com/el/tvdjJrFPTjeCJ-6qtJ4C0mJRR8E1uFS6XcSskmLZL0I=/VWtJVLZSH6o4jFd85CcuzD5YkYmC9vngXZABa3_e3iw=?refcode=em22_220114_MM1_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220114_MM1_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email

# A note from Jahmal:
I was headed to Jewel off 60th and Cottage, but couldn’t make it there because of an incident around 63rd and cottage. Red tape surrounded the intersection and there were a lot of cops outside. “Aw man it ain’t serious unless it’s the red tape!” That’s what the teenagers in my after school explorers program used to say when I’d drop them off at home at night. “Aw man that’s just the yellow tape in front of your apartment. It ain’t serious unless it’s red tape.” Anyway, I knew it was serious because I saw red tape.

I rerouted from Jewel and ended up at a neighborhood Walmart. Not my favorite choice, but I went to Mariano’s a few days back for taco Tuesday ingredients. Today I’m making my famous chicken mushroom dish, and a lot of places don’t carry cream of mushroom soup. Come on, man! Anyhow I hopped out on 47th and cottage, ready for a Walmart adventure. I said hello to the armed guards dressed in all black as I walked in.
---
| [Donate Today!](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=0310ed208e&e=339f142c50 "Donate Today!")
---
| After I grabbed my veggies, onion, celery and carrots, I headed to the aisle to find my cream of mushroom. A young store clerk stopped me and asked how I was doing and if I needed any help finding anything. I mean he made eye contact and everything. I thanked him for his exemplary customer service skills and I walked away shocked. Dang, am I at Trader Joe’s, Whole Foods or Walmart?

Okay, well this young store clerk, a young black man, was so awesome, I went to find a store manager and told him how amazing this employee was. We walked together to find this young man and I asked the store manager if he’d take our picture. He did and I thanked the young man again for everything. That type of spirit will take him a long way in life.

While we were taking the photo an elderly lady passed by us and yelled, “Get out my way.” I said “excuse me mam, I apologize. I was taking a photo with this young man because of his exemplary customer service skills.” She said, “Well taking a photo and getting out of my way is two different things.” I laughed inside and kept it moving. She was right though, I was in the way.
Okay so I grabbed all my ingredients and headed to the beer section. Lately I’ve been drinking non-alcoholic Heineken. No alcohol for me nowadays. Really no time man, just focusing on the election, staying healthy and of course my number one job is keeping my fiancé happy.

I asked another young store clerk if they sold non-alcoholic beer and he said “What’s there is there.” I mean he had horrible customer service. I didn’t complain and go find a manager, (would’ve been funny if I had found the same manager) I just went to check out.

As I was nearing the counter the young store clerk with exemplary customer service stopped me and said, “Are you Jahmal Cole?” He said he knew of my nonprofit and had gone on a field trip with my team once. He said he was a member of a nonprofit program in Chicago called Champs MALE Mentoring Program. I said “oh yeah Vondale Singleton‘s org right?” We shared a hug. I told him that Vondale isn’t only a mentor to him but he’s a role model of mine as well. Vondale showed me by example what it means to show up and support other nonprofit orgs in Chicago. Lots of times the perception is that we compete for grants but there really isn’t any competition. We just move in love. I absolutely love Vondale Singleton and I told the young man that I’d let him know we ran into each other.

As I left Walmart I said goodbye to the armed security guards in all black and a lady that had been waiting for a cart took mine as I left the store. Jeeze, is there a cart shortage? Haha. Just messing. I left feeling pretty upbeat.

I crossed the street and an elder man in a tan Jeep rolled his window down and said “Be safe young man, we need you out here.” I stopped with my bags in hand and said thank you sir. I’m Jahmal Cole. He said I know. He said come closer. He pulled out a money clip with hundreds of dollars and behind the money was an old business card. He said, you gave me this card almost 10 years ago when you were selling your self-published books downtown. The card said Role Model Movement, Inc., which is the parent name of my business now. I named it Role Model Movement because most of my role models growing up are now in prison and I started volunteering at Cook County Jail over ten years ago trying to bring role models to the jail to talk to the young men. I started my org My Block My Hood My City from these interactions with three young men in the jail because I realized that a lot of them had never traveled outside of their blocks and needed exposure.

Anyhow, long story long. This man in the tan jeep kept this card for so many years and he says he’s going to support my congressional run. I took a photo of him with the card.
Wow, life is amazing, man. I need to go to Walmart more often. In one day I met a young man that had exemplary customer service skills who knew of my after school explorers program, was a graduate of champs mentoring, an org that I fully support, and then I met this elder gentleman who kept a business card I made from vista print nearly 10 years ago.

I’m so blessed to be alive. I love Chicago and I’m staying present for these moments. Let’s go!!!! [Support the wave](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=7da1fcd926&e=339f142c50)!

Yours in service,

Jahmal Cole

I’m thrilled to share more exciting news and updates as we start this new year together. This week, we picked up over a dozen new endorsements from state and local officials. These new endorsements mean that our coalition now has the support of over 50 elected officials across the state, along with the support of progressive advocacy groups like People’s Action and Neighbor to Neighbor Massachusetts. I’m humbled to have their support in our mission to put people first. | | | | | Finally, I have been out meeting with people all across the state over the last few weeks. On my trip to the Cape last weekend, I talked with residents about the issues affecting them the most – housing, climate, education – and how we can tackle them together and win the change all our families need. Thanks to grassroots supporters like you, we’re meeting and organizing with residents all across the state, and we’re already planning out future trips. subject: A mob? A riot? What did she do?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michael Brown for Governor • P
body:
It was a violent mob at the Capitol and Whitmer egged them on. I know because I was there. | | | |
---
| | | Peter: When Governor Whitmer last year declared, “we are a nation of laws, not mobs,” she conveniently forgot that **she incited** [_a violent mob at the State Capitol in Lansing_](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=70f83d0e01&e=0636b97700) in 2012.

**I know because I was there.**

In 2012, I was the senior executive officer to the Field Commander of the State Police responsible for the mobilization and protection of the State Capitol and the employees who worked there.

I had just witnessed the massive destruction of the Wisconsin Capitol in 2011 and the [hundreds of thousands of dollars in damage](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=e61a3abc92&e=0636b97700) that was done. My task was to mobilize as many troopers as needed to protect the safety of our legislators and capitol staff, as well as protect the State Capitol property.

_**Little did I know all my efforts and planning would be sabotaged by Gretchen Whitmer.**_

The issue of the day was Right to Work legislation which had just passed. It would prevent forced mandatory dues for workers and would expand job opportunities in Michigan. It was legislation that was good for Michigan.

But for Gretchen Whitmer, it was an opportunity to grandstand.
---
| [ ](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=e9de14944e&e=0636b97700)
---
| After **Whitmer incited the crowd, yelling into a microphone, “We’re gonna fight! Are you?”** she later bragged about how she “threw open the doors of the Capitol” to let thousands of screaming protesters in to disrupt the process.

I had completed many days of planning to mobilize 500 troopers to protect the Capitol. I had no idea that Gretchen Whitmer would endanger every citizen, employee, Representative and Senator by her open disregard for safety and breach of security of the Capitol.

To me, Governor Gretchen Whitmer takes the cake with her hypocrisy. Raging about insurrections when she openly endangered security protocols with raging rhetoric inciting the crowd and then bragged about it on television.

**She was pushing mob rule then, not legitimate government.**

I agree with her statement that we are a nation of laws, not mobs. _The difference is, I believe it._

**Whitmer and her hypocrisy need to go._It’s time for a level headed leader in the Governor’s office, not a grandstanding career politician._**

Won’t you join me?

Consider sending a donation today. **[$100, $50, $25. Any amount helps](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=fde5f47d2c&e=0636b97700).**

Do you agree it is time we _Dump Whitmer_?

Please help today.

Sincerely,

Michael Brown

| | **\- American Rescue Plan Responsible for Indiana’s Brighter Future, Not Republicans - ** This week, Governor Eric Holcomb touted a strong Indiana during his State of the State address. But here’s the kicker: the state’s economic success is because Democrats – not Republicans – stood by Hoosiers when it mattered most. The state’s bright future is because of the American Rescue Plan. What the Rescue Plan accomplished for the state:
1. Fully-funded the state’s economic development program (known as READI),
2. Provided $250 million to expand broadband access,
3. Handed teachers a much-needed (and deserved) pay raise,
4. Funded public schools at levels not seen in a decade,
5. Infused $540 million for childcare services, and
6. Provided revenue relief to communities in all 92 counties.

Here’s what Hoosiers need to know: Every single Indiana Republican - including the Governor - opposed the Rescue Plan. Now, Republicans are attempting a partisan tightrope walk where they describe these investments as “socialism” while still taking the dough and touting the achievements it creates. Indiana Democrats are not going to let their culture wars and extreme partisanship mislead Hoosier families. Starting next month, Democrats will once again hit the road to share with voters about how the Party’s economic agenda is creating a better future for them. This will include the state’s READI program and infrastructure investments via the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act.
**\- INDems Statement On Indiana House Passing “Constitutional Carry”, Bucking Majority of Hoosiers and Law Enforcement - ** Please read the following statement from Chairman Schmuhl after the Indiana Republican Party forced House Bill 1077 through the Indiana House of Representatives: _“This is what the Indiana Democratic Party meant when it said Republicans will put their extremism before anything else. If the Indiana GOP get their way and sign House Bill 1077 into law, they will ignore the will of voters and state and municipal law enforcement who worry about public safety - all to fulfill an out-of-touch agenda. Whether it’s handing firearms to bad actors, discrediting COVID-19 vaccines, or politicizing classrooms, Indiana Republicans would rather divide families and communities with their partisan culture wars than actually create a better future for Hoosiers.” -**said Mike Schmuhl, Chairman of the Indiana Democratic Party**_ **NOTE:** This Indiana GOP culture war goes against a [majority of Hoosiers](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40695603/325509910/-43825266?FFF.01.14.22=FFF.01.14.22&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmZjMTk0ZC04NTc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PCvNdEKLD6ZNDCLOCIr8NrsHYgvglsw_QO91xu5c5Vo=&emci=22a1db68-5775-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=b2fc194d-8575-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=4925535) AND [law enforcement](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40695608/325509923/-1603166800?FFF.01.14.22=FFF.01.14.22&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmZjMTk0ZC04NTc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PCvNdEKLD6ZNDCLOCIr8NrsHYgvglsw_QO91xu5c5Vo=&emci=22a1db68-5775-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=b2fc194d-8575-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=4925535) who are opposed to this measure.
**\- Indiana Republicans Sympathizing with Nazism, Extremist Groups - ** State Senator Scott Baldwin’s freudian slip this last week continued a disturbing pattern within the Indiana Republican Party: they favor showing sympathy to Nazism and other forms of extremism rather than telling the truth and upholding our American values. Baldwin became a national embarrassment when he claimed educators must be impartial when [teaching Nazism](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40695616/325509934/-1840421959?FFF.01.14.22=FFF.01.14.22&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmZjMTk0ZC04NTc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PCvNdEKLD6ZNDCLOCIr8NrsHYgvglsw_QO91xu5c5Vo=&emci=22a1db68-5775-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=b2fc194d-8575-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=4925535). These extremism views followed a bombshell report last year revealing the Senator once had an “[annual membership](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40695618/325509937/1505763223?FFF.01.14.22=FFF.01.14.22&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmZjMTk0ZC04NTc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PCvNdEKLD6ZNDCLOCIr8NrsHYgvglsw_QO91xu5c5Vo=&emci=22a1db68-5775-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=b2fc194d-8575-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=4925535)” to the Oath Keepers, the domestic terrorist group responsible for the Insurrection against the United States of America. Indiana Democrats continue to repeat one simple request for the Indiana Republican Party: condemn Nazism, the Oath Keepers, and the rise of extremism across Indiana. So far, Republicans have remained silent on these incidents. When a [Republican voter](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40695623/325509939/1937374816?FFF.01.14.22=FFF.01.14.22&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMmZjMTk0ZC04NTc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PCvNdEKLD6ZNDCLOCIr8NrsHYgvglsw_QO91xu5c5Vo=&emci=22a1db68-5775-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=b2fc194d-8575-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=4925535) flew a Nazi flag outisde the town of Macy last year, Governor Eric Holcomb and Indiana GOP Chairman Kyle Hupfer said nothing. And when Baldwin was found connected to the Oath Keepers, they also issued no comment. The Republicans’ strategy to show sympathy to white supremacy (not to rattle some voters) reveals the Indiana Republican Party as an organization that values un-American extremism over democracy and creating a better future for Hoosier families.
**\- We Want You: Run for Office in 2022 - ** New year, new vibe: Democrats are calling on leaders to step up and join us in the effort to elect hard working leaders up and down the ticket. That means we need real public servants to run for office. Last week marked the beginning period when Hoosiers can formally file their candidacy for office. Democrats are looking to build its bench from the ground up, and whether you’re running for precinct committee person, state delegate, or state office - we want you to help us create a better future for Indiana, our communities, and our families. _Hey, Peter! Our team is hard at work on Gov. Lujan Grisham's reelection campaign, and we're so grateful for top supporters like you. That's why we'd like to let you know what the Governor is working on – and how you can help her win._
|
---
**Launching into 2022**
From supporting small businesses to cutting taxes, the Governor has a proven track record – and it's clear New Mexicans are thankful for her work. Because of grassroots supporters like you, Gov. Lujan Grisham reached all of her end-of-year fundraising goals.
As we enter the Governor's reelection year, she's in a stronger position than ever to keep our state blue!
|
---
**Strengthening Education**
Gov. Lujan Grisham believes that New Mexico's next generation of leaders deserves the very best education. That's why she recently proposed legislation that will raise teacher pay and attract the best educators in the region.
Education has always been a priority for the Governor. In the past, she has expanded educator development, delivered thousands of Chromebooks to students during the pandemic, invested in our schools, and more.
|

subject: I have some thoughts on Kyrsten Sinema

Peter: Sen. Kyrsten Sinema just announced that she will not support the filibuster reform that Democrats are counting on to pass critical voting rights legislation – and, to put it mildly, I have some thoughts on that.
I am shocked by the absolute absurdity of Sen. Sinema yesterday. She took to the Senate floor to talk about the filibuster as if it's some tool of civility or compromise when the GOP is actively exploiting it to block legislation that would protect our most fundamental, cherished right – the right to vote.
**Let's be honest with ourselves here: The Senate is broken.** When I served in the House, I watched as countless bipartisan bills that would move our country forward died in McConnell's Senate time and time again. Now, Democrats technically have control, but Sen. Sinema has the power to obstruct policies that the vast majority of Americans support.
I won't mince words, I don't know what compelled Sen. Sinema to serve in Congress, but I do know that she _refuses_ to do anything – anything at all – for working families like the one that I grew up in. **I don't know if she forgot where she came from or who she's there to fight for.**
**But I do know that I'm done with having our entire Democratic agenda rest in the hands of a single senator. It's time that we expand our Senate majority. **Now, with Sen. Grassley facing record-low approval ratings, we've got a real chance to do it right here in Iowa.
**Peter, you have my word: Send me to the Senate, and I will be the 50th vote we need to reform the filibuster.** I'll fight tooth and nail to protect voting rights, raise the federal minimum wage, and pass the PRO Act to strengthen workers' rights and our unions.
**I'm doing everything within my power to defeat Sen. Grassley and move our country forward, I just need you with me. [So please, can you donate $5 right now to defeat Sen. Grassley, expand our Senate majority, and pass critical legislation to move our country forward?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40695894/325511078/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk606-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTcyNDIwMS04Njc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=s3A-X88kShk4A4IlwqlGrZz1IG5r-jR_Payiw3cFgFo=)**
I know days like this can be frustrating and hard. So thank you so much for standing with me and fighting today.

– Abby

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40695925/325511302/124312502?refcode=em21_emailheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjI4MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWI2NDI2Yy04Njc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aTfL96ZX0nscLUtGpzOnIloLZCdroVHMMilHRb5FFAs=)

Peter,

Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s birthday is tomorrow, and to celebrate, I'd like to talk about his profound legacy and what his activism has meant for my own campaign.

As a civil rights leader and minister, Dr. King led with compassion, love, and _fearless_ determination in the face of adversity.

Dr. King led a historic grassroots movement, joined by folks from all walks of life, in the pursuit of equal rights. His activism was grounded in nonviolence – from marches to boycotts to sit-ins, to further the mission for racial justice and equality for all. **These actions _still_ shape our movement for progress today.**

I'll point to one example in particular: In response to the violent racist backlash to the _Civil Rights Act_ , Dr. King, and civil rights leaders mobilized – leading one of the most influential marches in American history, from Selma to Montgomery, Alabama in 1965 in the name of voting rights.

The lasting impact of Selma is undeniable, Peter – and that August in 1965, Congress finally passed the _Voting Rights Act_ , a hard-fought victory to guarantee the right to vote for _all_ people. **But now, 57 years later, we are seeing the ugly part of history repeating itself.**

In response to historic voter gains in 2020, Republican legislatures around the country have introduced a slew of voter restriction bills, making it harder for people (especially Black and brown folks) to participate in our democracy. **These bills, which restrict mail-in voting, ballot boxes, and more, have passed in 17 states – an _unprecedented assault_ on the _Voting Rights Act._**

**[That's why we need to join together, in the spirit of Dr. King and the civil rights movement, to protect our democracy and restore the fundamental right to vote for all. Add your voice to our petition as we call on the Senate to pass the For the People Act to advance voting rights>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40695926/325511303/-1003023541?ms=em22_220114_mlk&refcode=em22_220114_mlk&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjI4MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWI2NDI2Yy04Njc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aTfL96ZX0nscLUtGpzOnIloLZCdroVHMMilHRb5FFAs=&emci=49ff09b2-4875-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=bab6426c-8675-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=34271788)** [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40695927/325511304/-1003023541?ms=em22_220114_mlk&refcode=em22_220114_mlk&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MjI4MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWI2NDI2Yy04Njc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aTfL96ZX0nscLUtGpzOnIloLZCdroVHMMilHRb5FFAs=&emci=49ff09b2-4875-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=bab6426c-8675-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=34271788) Something I especially love about Dr. King were his speeches, and the way he used words and his endless wisdom to speak truth to power and shed light on the gravest injustices.

One of his quotes comes to mind right now when I think about our own campaign for Congress, Peter:

_"Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate; only love can do that."_

That's what our campaign is centered around – **love.** Empathy, compassion, respect, and the cherishing of all people. As we continue to pursue a more equitable Florida and a country that works for all of us, I will always keep that in the forefront of my mission.

With love,

name: John Lira
subject: This is personal
body:
Peter, once again, Rep. Tony Gonzales has let us down.
Gonzales has voted against The Guard And Reserve GI Bill Parity Act that would expand GI Bill benefits for National Guard and reserve members by allowing any day getting paid and being in uniform on federal orders, including for training, to count toward eligibility for school tuition benefits under the post-9/11 GI Bill.
Thankfully, the bill still passed in the House — but this just shows how ready Gonzales is to leave service members behind.
This is personal. After I served 11 years in the Marine Corps, it was GI bill benefits that allowed me to earn an associate’s degree from San Antonio College and a bachelor’s degree from the University of Texas at San Antonio.
**And to think that Gonzales would make earning these benefits harder — after these National Guard and reserve members risked their lives for years to serve our country — is despicable.**
It’s time we hold him accountable for decisions against veterans like this by voting him out of office this year.

We must do it again, but I have to admit I'm a little concerned. Our campaign just isn't seeing the fundraising numbers or the unprecedented level of engagement that turned so many people out to vote the last two cycles. It's going to take an even bigger turnout to maintain Democratic control of the House and Senate -- I know we can do it, but we cannot slow down now. = = = I know it's easy to get burned out with the seemingly endless campaigning and nonstop electioneering. I wish it didn't have to be this way, but when Republicans continue to rely on wealthy super-donors and corporate PAC money, Democrats simply have no choice. Our grassroots donors are the backbone of this campaign, and your time, energy, and -- yes, donations -- is how we will win. Let's make the 2022 Blue Wave even bigger, together. Thank you so much for your support, Christy = *

| Peter,

Can you believe that it’s already 2022? In a moment, I’m going to ask you to make your first contribution of 2022 — but first, I want to take a moment to reflect on all that we accomplished together in 2021.

**I cosponsored** 412 pieces of legislation, 77% of which were bipartisan.

**I was proud to introduce** legislation to support the mental health of students on college campuses. Mental health support and suicide prevention are issues that are near and dear to my heart, and I am proud to play any role in promoting mental health care.

**I was excited to support** the historic bipartisan infrastructure bill, which included over $1 billion in investments in Pennsylvania’s roads and bridges.

**I fought for** **the expansion** of the Child Tax Credit, which benefited over 133,000 kids right here in the district.

**I secured** federal contracts for local companies right here in the Lehigh Valley.

**I cast my vote** to protect reproductive health care in a piece of legislation that is especially crucial given the restrictive abortion laws going into place around the country.

Representing this district is an extraordinary privilege and one that I do not take lightly. I am committed to delivering results for our communities. | **It’s hard to believe that I’ve been in Congress working for San Diego communities for a full year.**

I am so proud of what we’ve accomplished during my time in Congress thus far, from delivering the Child Tax Credit to passing the historic Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act to passing the Build Back Better bill in the House. Additionally, I have stood with my colleagues to demand an extension of the federal eviction moratorium, cosponsored 342 pieces of legislation, and was the only freshman member appointed to Speaker Pelosi’s Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth.

I was also honored to support many projects and communities right here in the district, including securing infrastructure and airport updates as well as $3 million in Community Project Funding. I prioritized communication with my constituents through five town halls and responses to over 35,000 constituent letters.

There is still so much work to be done, which is why I’m so excited to be running for re-election to continue serving so many of my current constituents and a number of new communities in California’s newly-drawn 51st Congressional District. clean_body: I am so proud of what we’ve accomplished during my time in Congress thus far. | = | It’s hard to believe that I’ve been in Congress working for San Diego communities for a full year. I am so proud of what we’ve accomplished during my time in Congress thus far, from delivering the Child Tax Credit to passing the historic Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act to passing the Build Back Better bill in the House. Additionally, I have stood with my colleagues to demand an extension of the federal eviction moratorium, cosponsored 342 pieces of legislation, and was the only freshman member appointed to Speaker Pelosi’s Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. I was also honored to support many projects and communities right here in the district, including securing infrastructure and airport updates as well as $3 million in Community Project Funding. I prioritized communication with my constituents through five town halls and responses to over 35,000 constituent letters. Hello,
I picked up the newspaper yesterday to see a rather peculiar headline... a knee-slapper.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40699046/325524072/-42398318?refcode=em20220114pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYTdkYzUxNC05Njc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Mah2HiF1-V4u99lvn93HV-ngm0uoSGWHDwYi6hopo-Y=)
Apparently my opponent Senator Chuck Grassley is kicking off his 64th-year in elected office by announcing that he is for term limits... especially for others. (Awaiting word from him on age limitations for elected office.)

Neil Robinson Kumar

subject: I'm personally asking, Derek

body:
Two Republican super PACs jumped in this week alone. 😱
#
Derek,
I’ll cut straight to it 👇
Our team has a January mid-month fundraising goal of $20,000 online. So today I am personally asking:
Are you willing to **[kick in your first $5 to help us reach it and fuel our campaign to flip this Senate seat?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/40815?refcode=ema20220114-4202&t=1&akid=4202%2E434096%2EH8eOg4)**
Here’s why, Derek. Last time this Senate seat was up in Pennsylvania, it wound up being the single *most expensive* Senate race in history at that time. It even set a new record for statewide campaigns in PA. Despite all that, Democrats were outspent by the GOP, losing by just over 1% of the vote. 🙄
Now we’re running the risk of being outspent in Pennsylvania again in 2022. Not only are self-funding millionaire GOP candidates like Dr. Oz + David McCormick snapping up TV ad air time like hot cakes.
**In the last week alone, not one, but TWO Republican super PACs collectively dropped over $1 MILLION on TV ads across the state...** and we’re still 11 months from Election Day... 😱
That’s why I’m asking for your help to raise another $20,000 by midnight on Sunday, January 16. Mid-month grassroots goals help us keep on track with our opponents’ millions. Reaching our goal will help fund the next expansion of our statewide organizing operation — something our wealthy GOP opponents don’t have + can’t compete with.
**This would mean a *lot* to me, Derek:[Will you be among the 50 folks from Cresco we need in order to reach our mid-month goal of $20,000 in grassroots donations? My team + I crunched the numbers, and we think we can get there if enough of yinz are willing to help out.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/40815?refcode=ema20220114-4202&t=2&akid=4202%2E434096%2EH8eOg4)**
**[Contribute $5](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/40815?refcode=em20220114-4202&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=4202%2E434096%2EH8eOg4)**
The commitment of this team is honestly surreal — and I’m so grateful to everyone who can chip in today. (**[Including you?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/40815?refcode=ema20220114-4202&t=22&akid=4202%2E434096%2EH8eOg4)**)
Thank you, thank you, THANK YOU. 😭
John
John Fetterman
Lt. Governor of Pennsylvania
P.S. I'm deeply grateful that our grassroots team is doing so much to help us fight back against out-of-control GOP spending in Pennsylvania. **[We think we could get to our $20,000 goal by Sunday at midnight if around 50 folks from Cresco are able to chip in. Could I count on you to be among them?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/40815?refcode=ema20220114-4202&t=23&akid=4202%2E434096%2EH8eOg4)**

THANK YOU for allowing me to serve as your attorney general for the last eight years. It has been the honor of a lifetime. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40699557/325532802/-1309710229?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzM2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGQ0NGZjOS05OTc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=79iKdUfMvNzJ0WIvgWpc2t49cxPNBn5wQsJbrl01nOA=&emci=7b3a3ebb-8e75-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=64d44fc9-9975-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=9499186) | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40699558/325532803/-1829470680?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzM2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGQ0NGZjOS05OTc1LWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=79iKdUfMvNzJ0WIvgWpc2t49cxPNBn5wQsJbrl01nOA=&emci=7b3a3ebb-8e75-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&emdi=64d44fc9-9975-ec11-94f6-c896650d4442&ceid=9499186) My fellow Virginians— THANK YOU for allowing me to serve as your attorney general for the last eight years. It has been the honor of a lifetime. As my time as AG comes to a close, I leave with an immense sense of peace, pride, and satisfaction in the good work we were able to do for Virginians, and my only regret is that we won't get the opportunity to do even more. I believe we fundamentally changed Virginians expectations of their Attorney General, and expanded what people believe is possible from this office. For a generation under Republican control, this office had been on the sidelines in the fight for Virginians rights, or worse, it was sometimes used to deny or infringe on Virginians rights. But we put the protection and expansion of rights, justice, opportunity, and equality at the center of our work, and the results were historic. It started at the very beginning of my first term when I said **we would not defend a discriminatory and unconstitutional marriage ban against LGBT Virginians.** We won, and we never slowed down for eight years. We **completely eliminated Virginia’s rape kit backlog** and transformed how Virginia works to prevent and respond to sexual and domestic violence. We **legalized cannabis.** We **gave DREAMers a shot** at an affordable education here in Virginia. We **protected LGBT Virginians from discrimination.** We **protected Virginians’ healthcare** from constant attack by Republicans. We **protected reproductive rights** and access to the full range of healthcare services women need. We recovered **hundreds of millions of dollars for Virginia consumers** who had been ripped off by unscrupulous business. We **led the fight against the opioid crisis** and sued the big pharma companies that helped create and prolong it. We **created Virginia’s first Worker Protection Unit and first permanent Office of Civil Rights,** and did groundbreaking work. We **launched an investigation into clergy abuse** in Virginia. We led the nation in the effort to get the **Equal Rights Amendment recognized** and **sued to block Trump’s Muslim ban.** We **protected the very foundations of our democracy** against relentless attack by the Trump administration. We p**assed new laws to prevent gun violence,** like one gun a month, expanded background checks, a red flag law, and we successfully defended all those in court. And I could go on and on—we brought the first lawsuit against a law enforcement agency for discriminatory conduct. We did the **first investigation into racial discrimination** in a school district. We’ve **taken down Confederate propaganda,** defended the Chesapeake Bay, **supported the push for clean energy** and on and on. All of this and so much more was possible because of you, and the faith you put in me. I worked every day to be worthy of that trust, and I hope that I’ve made you proud. We’ve changed the lives of millions of Virginians for the better, but we know that the work is never truly done. You can count on me to stay in the fight for the values we share, and to be a voice for justice, equality, and opportunity. Thank you, once again, for allowing me to serve, and I look forward to new adventures and new challenges in the years ahead. \-- Mark Herring

**Attorney General Mark Herring is fighting every day for justice, equality, and opportunity for ALL Virginians.** _"Serving as your Attorney General has been the honor of my life. We led the nation in the effort to get the Equal Rights Amendment recognized and sued to block Trump’s Muslim ban. Fellow Conservative,

As a fifth-generation Floridian, Iraq War veteran, and proud Representative of Florida’s 17th Congressional District, I ran for Congress for the same reason I joined the U.S. Army - _I like to fight on the side of liberty._

Twenty years ago, I first answered the call to serve following the September 11, 2001 attacks and enlisted in the U.S. Army.

In the U.S. Army, I spent one year as a commissioned Airborne Infantry Officer and three years in the Army JAG Corps, serving as a Captain with the 25th Infantry Division in Operation Iraqi Freedom.

**I know firsthand that America is the greatest beacon of freedom and liberty in the history of mankind, and our U.S. Armed Forces provide the greatest defense of these values that are revered around the world.**
I use my own experience in Congress to advocate for our men and women in uniform because I understand their struggles. When Biden **FAILED** America with the disastrous Afghanistan withdrawal, it was an affront to every single servicemember and their families who have sacrificed so much to this country. **Biden has made it clear that he does not prioritize Americans - the people HE is supposed to serve. **

This abdication of duty by the Commander-in-Chief must be dealt with head-on, and that means Republicans taking back the House of Representatives. We must unite as one conservative voice against this gross incompetence so we can take back the House THIS YEAR.

| [**_UNITE AS ONE CONSERVATIVE VOICE_
CONTRIBUTE TO HELP ››**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=67d880495d7b42a7bcd647827f4c7f2b&_e=6elHba90E_K4KsLxwXdvarpSoV2iLI5EEcCyulJEw6DzRjOQ9MLR8rVFbufoREOthbDFzlvnR5xpCmO3X1io5ao8DRyK4vMyhX6FbXcu2vHWLGIC3GPGHZEtJClnop6Y6uqrrI_Q1XMeUSvLpu_CNK-rFbQVfbM1ar9aTir-jkN1h3VqdjDsIdHySIASZZ835twl7t1fYyQbUbC2jZcUJF_BJxRb2IwqBu-g05TqH7Dqal1I-VzuYDaGewQWoqFVYOgwh4UOoBqvXQw91bGejWKiowZjHa-CaYemquhxCb20QMZ58vyvKo6lInV7VMMfh1jPFCjruB0rZK4BgLv8yGTc9RvLl5IH8cKrOsy4Jhx3S36lIaxNkRqNtJ3CMmzo)

We know that the issue in D.C. is Democrat leadership – plain and simple. So far, they have:

* Allowed inflation to reach all-time highs
* Stripped away your freedoms and imposed mandates that have done nothing to control the COVID-19 pandemic
* Created a border crisis that President Trump finally had under control
* Left Americans stranded in Afghanistan after one of the most embarrassing military withdrawals in U.S. history that also led to the loss of life

body:
Talking all things Bitcoin, decentralization, and politics.
# [](https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20220114-514-footer-ak&t=2&akid=514%2E90090%2EX0oPNq)
_“This decentralized power concept is very important... the reason why we have the democracy issues, the reason why we haven’t seen broader economic opportunity is because we do have this concentration of economic power.”_ — Morgan Harper
---
Morgan just appeared on the podcast _What Bitcoin Did_ and talked about removing corporate money from politics, how Bitcoin can help level the playing field, and taking politics out of policy.
This is _exactly_ what makes our campaign so different. We can’t keep having status-quo candidates who don’t have the open mind to address new and upcoming policy issues like Bitcoin and cryptocurrency.
We have to demystify cryptocurrency and Bitcoin, because the potential of this tech is to level the playing field for people who may otherwise be shut out of the economy. It could give anyone in Ohio a chance to participate — not just already rich and powerful gatekeepers!
We’re all about that 👏 and that’s why we don’t take a dime of corporate or super PAC money.
**That’s where you come in****:[_Can you donate $5 to our grassroots campaign before our mid-month fundraising deadline on January 15 at midnight? * * *
**Kyrsten Sinema is out of step with Arizonans — and not just Democrats.**
Sinema is opposing bills and reforms supported by broad, bipartisan majorities of Arizonans. clean_body: Peter, I am grateful every single day to live in Florida. Thanks to the leadership of our great governor and my husband, Ron DeSantis, Florida is the freest state in the United States. But across the country, that freedom has come under assault as politicians have cast aside their citizens' liberty. Thankfully, Florida has a governor who stands courageously in the face of sharp opposition to protect our freedom. Thanks to his leadership, Floridians have a right to earn a living without heavy-handed mandates and kids have an opportunity to thrive. Over the last three years, Governor DeSantis led Florida to record-breaking economic success, which has become the envy of America. Our tax burden is the lowest per capita in the nation, our job growth far outpaces the national average, we are leading the nation in business formations, and our tourism industry is soaring even beyond its pre-pandemic levels. Despite this, federal policies are creating negative headwinds. To that end, Governor DeSantis has proposed a $1 billion gas tax holiday to help Floridians combat rising inflation and gas prices. With politicians in Democrat-controlled cities and states AGAIN making the disastrous decision to close schools, our governor continues to stand strong for parents and students to keep schools open! We have a governor who is committed to protecting parental rights -- he believes parents must have a say in their child's education, from the curriculum to the decision to vaccinate their child against COVID. "" Governor DeSantis has banned Critical Race Theory in our schools. Keeping our communities safe also requires enforcing our border laws. With the federal government's indifference towards enforcing the rule of law, our governor is taking action. Governor DeSantis banned sanctuary cities and was the first governor to send reinforcements to Texas to help combat the surge taking place at our southern border. He's fought to stop clandestine flights that drop off illegal immigrants in Florida. He is also introducing proposals to stop these relocation efforts and is hold those who help facilitate such underhanded policies accountable. He understands that enforcing a strong border means protecting our communities by keeping drugs off our streets and out of our children's hands, and he refuses to allow the federal government's human smuggling operation to go on unchallenged. Florida's citizens shouldn't be forced to bear the burden of the federal government's immigration ineptitude. Florida counted over 11 million ballots on Election Day. | **HAPPY NEW YEAR!** Dear Friend, Even though I am new to American politics and would be the first to admit that I'm hardly an experienced career politician, the phoniness and disinformation pushed by the mainstream media continues to shock me. Take this, for example; under Oklahoma State Law, if no candidate in the Republican primary contest gets 50% in a multi-candidate race, the two top vote-getters face off in a runoff in a second election. Even though a supposedly respectable statewide poll often cited by establishment shows that Senator James Lankford's support has dropped from 63% to 52% - before I have even begun the public phase of my campaign - the Oklahoma media contends that Lankford has an insurmountable lead and that his political position is "comfortable." With the help of professionals, my campaign has conducted its own polling and we learned some amazing things. I will get Lankford under 50% and beat him in the runoff. In all honesty, in the fifty-three counties that I have visited, I have yet to find an Oklahoman who actually likes him and who is not offended by his arrogance, pomposity and sense of entitlement. *** When Oklahoma Republicans learn that Senator James Lankford betrayed President Trump and moved on the Senate floor to certify the election of Joe Biden, his support drops into the 20s. ** *** When Oklahoma Republicans learn that Senator James Lankford apologized to the Black community after being criticized by Black Lives Matter and said that asking legitimate questions about the honesty of the 2020 election vote count is "racist" \- his support drops to the 20s.** *** When voters hear actual tape recordings of Senator Lankford disrespecting, denigrating and trash-talking President Trump and his wife on mutual social occasions when they didn 't know they were being taped, they will be offended and outraged and his support will continue to drop. These will make powerful radio commercials.** *** When Oklahoma Republicans learn that Senator James Lankford voted to award citizenship to illegal immigrants who have poured across our Southern Border, his support virtually collapses.** Senator Lankford is a ten-year veteran of Washington who has generally received uncritical press from the Oklahoma media. The people of Oklahoma do not yet know me nor know the differences I have with Senator Lankford, but I guarantee that by the end of my campaign every single Oklahoma Republican will know of his disgraceful record, and he will be able to return to the Ministry where perhaps he could be more effective than he has been as a US Senator. I am a Pastor, businessman, father of five and husband. I never dreamed that I would be undertaking this historic challenge, but after much prayer, I am absolutely certain that this is what the Lord wants me to do as part of his plan to save this nation. My wife and I have found nothing more offensive than Mrs. Lankford's attack on me, claiming that I am "not a good Christian" because I choose to challenge the diminutive junior Senator. Only the Lord can make such judgements. Between a crashing economy, record-high gasoline prices, food shortages, Red Chinese infiltration at all levels of our Government (including the Congress), and a federally-backed medical establishment that is intent on forcing every American to take a COVID-19 vaccination, which I believe to be neither safe nor effective--our country is in deep trouble. At the same time, Chinese Communist Party interests have quietly bought up over 300,000 acres of prime Oklahoma farm land. At the same time, the state and federal education bureaucracies try to force their radical critical race theory philosophy which blames white people for all of society's historical and current ills on our children. **Senator James Lankford is doing nothing to fight any of these battles. He 's sitting on $4 million in out-of-state campaign contributions that have purchased his silence. When he isn't in Washington; you can find him in Texas, where his actual ranch is. Frankly, we don't need a third Senator from Texas - we need a Senator who will stand up for Oklahoma.** I recently met with President Trump in Florida to tell him of the amazing progress we are making in our campaign; we have received over $600,000 in contributions from over 500,000 individual Oklahomans. We are building a grassroots organization in all seventy-seven counties. In many cases, county Republican leaders tell me they have not seen nor heard from James Lankford in years. President Trump knows that I am a reliable "America First" candidate and that I fully support his reform agenda. I only pray we can win control of the Senate and the House before it is too late. Won't you please send another contribution to help us build the war-chest necessary to compete with Senator James Lankford and his mega contributions from the special interests who would sell our country down the drain? Your [contribution](https://100726.trk.directiq13.com/hit?sid=xq9v0vhzy30piydpx&linkid=1&link=703fec653c9244c1bd7d207a720132fe) for $10, $25, $50, $75, $100, $200, $500, or even $1,000, would be a Godsend right now. I am proud to say that General Michael Flynn and longtime Republican strategist Roger Stone are taking an active role in our campaign, and both of them are working actively to help me raise money for the fight ahead--but we urgently need your help. Please let me hear from you today. Kendra sends her very best for the new year. Sincerely, **Jackson Lahmeyer**

body:
Hey, folks!

This week, Ron Johnson announced he’s running for re-election, so we went to Oshkosh — his own backyard — to sit down with a few Wisconsinites and talk about the issues that matter most in their community.

We discussed the rising cost of prescription drugs, the relentless attacks on voting rights and reproductive freedom, the importance of guaranteeing paid leave and affordable child care, and the urgent need to address PFAS contamination in our water.

While Ron Johnson’s busy spreading disinformation and refusing to work for the people who elected him, I’m traveling the state, asking folks how I can help, and letting them know we’re going to get things done for them — just as soon as we flip this seat.

Look, I’m no stranger to running in statewide elections. When I ran for State Treasurer in 2018, I flipped nine Trump counties, and Ron Johnson’s very own Winnebago County was one of them. I’ve won in his backyard before, and I can do it again to defeat him this November.
