subject: Susan Wild, Racism and "Real Americans"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kevin Dellicker for Congress
body:
Lehigh Valley Voters Shouldn't Feel Guilty for Opposing Bad Policies | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/dellickerforcongress/china-op-ed-09dec21-15741796?e=1090c5c412)
---
|
---
|
---
| | **Susan Wild, Racism and "Real Americans"** Last Tuesday, President Joe Biden traveled to Atlanta to deliver a fiery speech about race and voting. His message? If you don’t support his election reform proposals, you are a racist. Biden’s speech has been widely criticized as cheap and divisive. “Do you want to be on the side of Abraham Lincoln or Jefferson Davis?” he bellowed. Senator Dick Durbin of Illinois, a member of Democratic Party leadership, said Biden “went a little too far.” Apparently, even some progressives thought it was over the top. But not Susan Wild. Our congresswoman from PA-07 is fundraising off Biden’s message, calling it “a powerful speech” and repeating its most offensive lines in an email to supporters. She also blasts her Democratic colleague, Senator Kyrsten Sinema from Arizona, suggesting that she is in the “wrong party.” Susan Wild wrote, “I am sick of Democrats like Kyrsten Sinema who don’t act like Democrats and who put their personal agendas ahead of the priorities of real Americans.” So, what is Kyrsten Sinema’s big offense? She actually supports President Biden’s election proposals. But she also refuses to change longstanding Senate filibuster rules to force them through Congress. Here’s what Senator Sinema said, “And while I continue to support these bills, I will not support separate actions that worsen the underlying disease of division infecting our country.” There are two takeaways from this episode for voters in PA-07. First, Susan Wild is not who she claims to be. She regularly presents herself as a bipartisan moderate to her constituents in the Lehigh Valley. Yet she consistently votes to ingratiate herself with her far-left colleagues in Washington. And now, as her reelection prospects worsen, Susan Wild seems to have caught the “disease of division” that wiser Democrats have warned her against. There are a lot of Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema Democrats in the Lehigh Valley. To you, I say this: Susan Wild has made it clear that you are not welcome in her party. If you want a representative that puts our families and communities ahead of liberal ideologues, then I welcome you to join our team. Second, this idea of tirelessly linking race to policy is now an established part of the progressive playbook. It’s why things that have nothing to do with race are racially charged. When progressives cannot win arguments based on the merits, they resort to calling people names. And the worst name of all is to be called a racist. Don’t fall for it. These election reform bills are simply bad policy. The first piece of legislation is the so-called _Freedom to Vote Act_ , which would mandate at least two weeks of early voting and require no-excuse mail-in ballots nationwide. The second is the _John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, _which would require local jurisdictions to get federal approval prior to making certain election law changes. Americans overwhelmingly support strong voter identification laws and don’t want the federal government meddling in their local elections. Similar provisions were ruled unconstitutional just a few years ago. We can confidently oppose this legislation without engaging in a contrived debate about race. Eventually, Susan Wild may realize that no amount of campaign cash is worth selling out the people she represents. Lehigh Valley voters shouldn’t feel guilty about opposing bad legislation. This kind of ridiculous rhetoric only diminishes the real conversations we need to have on policy. I think the people of the Lehigh Valley want to be represented by someone who treats them like adults and doesn’t pander to extremists. In contrast, Susan Wild’s racial insinuations against moderate Democrats and Republicans may become her “deplorables” moment. That’s when mainstream Lehigh Valley voters finally figure out what Susan Wild really thinks of them- that they are not “real Americans.” Cooler heads will prevail. Please help me get to Washington and Keep America Free.

Sincerely,

---

clean_body: Lehigh Valley Voters Shouldn't Feel Guilty for Opposing Bad Policies | | | | | | | Susan Wild, Racism and "Real Americans" Last Tuesday, President Joe Biden traveled to Atlanta to deliver a fiery speech about race and voting. His message? If you don’t support his election reform proposals, you are a racist. Biden’s speech has been widely criticized as cheap and divisive. “Do you want to be on the side of Abraham Lincoln or Jefferson Davis?” he bellowed. Senator Dick Durbin of Illinois, a member of Democratic Party leadership, said Biden “went a little too far.” Apparently, even some progressives thought it was over the top. But not Susan Wild. Our congresswoman from PA-07 is fundraising off Biden’s message, calling it “a powerful speech” and repeating its most offensive lines in an email to supporters. She also blasts her Democratic colleague, Senator Kyrsten Sinema from Arizona, suggesting that she is in the “wrong party.” Susan Wild wrote, “I am sick of Democrats like Kyrsten Sinema who don’t act like Democrats and who put their personal agendas ahead of the priorities of real Americans.” So, what is Kyrsten Sinema’s big offense? She actually supports President Biden’s election proposals. But she also refuses to change longstanding Senate filibuster rules to force them through Congress. Here’s what Senator Sinema said, “And while I continue to support these bills, I will not support separate actions that worsen the underlying disease of division infecting our country.” There are two takeaways from this episode for voters in PA-07. First, Susan Wild is not who she claims to be. She regularly presents herself as a bipartisan moderate to her constituents in the Lehigh Valley. Yet she consistently votes to ingratiate herself with her far-left colleagues in Washington. And now, as her reelection prospects worsen, Susan Wild seems to have caught the “disease of division” that wiser Democrats have warned her against. There are a lot of Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema Democrats in the Lehigh Valley. To you, I say this: Susan Wild has made it clear that you are not welcome in her party. If you want a representative that puts our families and communities ahead of liberal ideologues, then I welcome you to join our team. Second, this idea of tirelessly linking race to policy is now an established part of the progressive playbook. It’s why things that have nothing to do with race are racially charged. When progressives cannot win arguments based on the merits, they resort to calling people names. And the worst name of all is to be called a racist. Don’t fall for it. These election reform bills are simply bad policy. The first piece of legislation is the so-called Freedom to Vote Act , which would mandate at least two weeks of early voting and require no-excuse mail-in ballots nationwide. The second is the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, which would require local jurisdictions to get federal approval prior to making certain election law changes. Americans overwhelmingly support strong voter identification laws and don’t want the federal government meddling in their local elections. Similar provisions were ruled unconstitutional just a few years ago. We can confidently oppose this legislation without engaging in a contrived debate about race. Eventually, Susan Wild may realize that no amount of campaign cash is worth selling out the people she represents. Lehigh Valley voters shouldn’t feel guilty about opposing bad legislation. This kind of ridiculous rhetoric only diminishes the real conversations we need to have on policy. I think the people of the Lehigh Valley want to be represented by someone who treats them like adults and doesn’t pander to extremists. In contrast, Susan Wild’s racial insinuations against moderate Democrats and Republicans may become her “deplorables” moment. That’s when mainstream Lehigh Valley voters finally figure out what Susan Wild really thinks of them- that they are not “real Americans.” Cooler heads will prevail. Please help me get to Washington and Keep America Free. ## A Long Islander Who Understands Long Island
# Nick Antonucci for New York’s
1st Congressional District in 2022
| **Hello Again! **

You heard from me just about a week ago, announcing Nick Antonucci's run for Congress in NY's 1st Congressional District. Some of you reached out right away with well-wishes, a few questions, and some greatly-appreciated donations.

Today I write to share some exciting news. Our first official campaign video is done and you are the first people invited to see it. This brief video (it's only about 3 minutes!) will give you a glimpse into the kind of candidate Nick is, and the kind of campaign he is running.

Then, at** 8pm on Saturday January 15 - _that's tomorrow _\- **you are invited to join Nick for his official "launch" speech online. We had, of course, hoped to do this as a live rally, but out of an abundance of caution, and with sensitivity to COVID-19 concerns, we would like to bring together supporters, and those interested in learning more, in a virtual space. This event will allow you to hear more from Nick about how he sees the problems on Long Island and, more importantly, the ways in which Congress can help solve these problems. If you agree that Suffolk County's economy is not working for everyone, especially young adults just out of school and retirees being priced out of their homes due to rising costs; if you believe that Congress has looked the other way while Long Island beaches, farmland, and groundwater have been ravaged by environmental mismanagement; and if you believe that Congress has a role to play in creating more innovative schools and funding post-secondary education... Nick's campaign has a place for you. And if you believe that the rule of law, the fundamentals of democracy, civil rights and human rights have all taken a beating lately, Nick's campaign has a place for you.
**_My call to action:_** **1. Click on [this link](https://ebricks03.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=af534523e1f2bdf0498b9f864&id=5bb1c9ef41&e=559f989661) and watch Nick's brief campaign kick-off video. ** **2. Join us for the Campaign Launch Speech on Saturday at 8pm by going to [NYNick4Congress.com](https://ebricks03.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=af534523e1f2bdf0498b9f864&id=8190aa02ca&e=559f989661)** **3. Like and share the video with friends, neighbors and family members.** **4\. Consider[donating to the campaign](https://ebricks03.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=af534523e1f2bdf0498b9f864&id=16f1f132f9&e=559f989661) as we are severely outmatched right now. Ask yourself "What would I give to have a representative that truly speaks for me?"** **5. Reach out with ANY questions or concerns you may have. [info@nynick4congress.com](mailto:info@nynick4congress.com)**
Please go to [NYNick4Congress.com](https://ebricks03.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=af534523e1f2bdf0498b9f864&id=700bea319d&e=559f989661) to learn more about Nick, his policy positions, what he hopes to accomplish, and how you can get involved with the campaign. And finally, please follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter: @NYNick4Congress.
**Wishing you nothing but the best,** **Dr. Laura Valente** **Campaign Manager**

Friend,
I am grateful every single day to live in Florida. Thanks to the leadership of our great governor and my husband, Ron DeSantis, **Florida is the freest state in the United States.**
[**CHIP IN $20.22 TO HELP GOVERNOR DESANTIS CONTINUE THE FIGHT FOR FLORIDA >>>**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=918e1ebd0f3b4e01b49f40d19d979a52&_e=RWezvpMT9LJfVUlgRZ4Xkp5OOM1aZ6Jhd7Gcdc-kt77z7ZjL3cH2GEceLDi-IHVvmwXpZdLSfxVTaJ_eBTbh6FJidwsvN-dRqojKFXeEWqW8jqkkYpGD4HxDMtqhlEl05sVr5p11wqNtV4w_Fs-vRklQWhqW9BTB9SAiJEHsMCOCKS28nvvEPd7fUUqRTrUapEVn8dVwguErA9jqX9KDQeVj-ZyEAdwjgNE4_Gbp3u-13g9zQku5lI0HPKne_zZY3c20HjIgN1WfytV41qjsqlfzToMPPh1x9v0GAIXzET0PgNBGJNB9qX4mHslmA_7EisA2WRl6IsXLHqbdB9GebmNrTDxIP5xOGNtw2olwNX6mWV8WeW4rmxsKdmb21tiC_EfDu_F-2dZQ9o7SHYPR5g%3D%3D)
But across the country, that freedom has come under assault as politicians have cast aside their citizens' liberty. Thankfully, Florida has a governor who stands courageously in the face of sharp opposition to protect our freedom. Thanks to his leadership, Floridians have a right to earn a living without heavy-handed mandates and kids have an opportunity to thrive.
Over the last three years, Governor DeSantis led Florida to record-breaking economic success, which has become the envy of America. Our tax burden is the lowest per capita in the nation, our job growth far outpaces the national average, we are leading the nation in business formations, and our tourism industry is soaring even beyond its pre-pandemic levels. Despite this, federal policies are creating negative headwinds. To that end, Governor DeSantis has proposed a $1 billion gas tax holiday to help Floridians combat rising inflation and gas prices.
With politicians in Democrat-controlled cities and states AGAIN making the disastrous decision to close schools, our governor continues to stand strong for parents and students to keep schools open! We have a governor who is committed to protecting parental rights -- he believes parents must have a say in their child's education, from the curriculum to the decision to vaccinate their child against COVID.
[**CHIP IN TO HELP GOVERNOR DESANTIS KEEP FLORIDA FREE!**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=918e1ebd0f3b4e01b49f40d19d979a52&_e=RWezvpMT9LJfVUlgRZ4Xkp5OOM1aZ6Jhd7Gcdc-kt77z7ZjL3cH2GEceLDi-IHVvmwXpZdLSfxVTaJ_eBTbh6FJidwsvN-dRqojKFXeEWqW8jqkkYpGD4HxDMtqhlEl05sVr5p11wqNtV4w_Fs-vRklQWhqW9BTB9SAiJEHsMCOCKS28nvvEPd7fUUqRTrUazTaDBLS1b9BSuQn0d728fpOyLBNgpq0nmY21d9QfOyz4vZoy9D68X66sfDbf5KalsK34MGb-tru0fIgPl4fWI18DgaLN9qvxyw6IaDrC0Tt1qN9VOrNn7LrSnhyNLNMjXyHKanXduwHP9w-Xv4ovidR09VA5m5Ho-1VOPAUwIF0e-YYzJhbIZQsxLu1m7mX9mG31oOssIAgDm-vWdE0B7Q%3D%3D "https://secure.winred.com/rondesantis/freedom-is-prevailing-fl-hf")
Governor DeSantis has banned Critical Race Theory in our schools. He believes that if a child is subjected to any hateful or discriminating propaganda in school, parents should have legal recourse.
As a husband and father, he knows the importance of keeping our communities safe, which is why he has made it clear that Florida stands for law and order. In addition to the $1,000 bonus checks he awarded to first responders last year, he's calling on the legislature to not only issue another round of bonuses this year but to increase pay for state law enforcement by up to 25% and to provide $5,000 bonuses for new officers, including those already serving in other states who want to relocate to Florida.
Keeping our communities safe also requires enforcing our border laws. With the federal government's indifference towards enforcing the rule of law, our governor is taking action. Governor DeSantis banned sanctuary cities and was the first governor to send reinforcements to Texas to help combat the surge taking place at our southern border. He's fought to stop clandestine flights that drop off illegal immigrants in Florida. He is also introducing proposals to stop these relocation efforts and is hold those who help facilitate such underhanded policies accountable.
He understands that enforcing a strong border means protecting our communities by keeping drugs off our streets and out of our children's hands, and he refuses to allow the federal government's human smuggling operation to go on unchallenged. Florida's citizens shouldn't be forced to bear the burden of the federal government's immigration ineptitude.
Florida counted over 11 million ballots on Election Day. Other states took days, if not weeks, to return ballots, ultimately casting doubt on the integrity of our electoral process. To ensure Florida continues to lead, Governor DeSantis banned "Zuckerbucks," ballot harvesting, the mass sending of mail-in ballots and he strengthened our voter ID laws. He's prepared to take additional measures this legislative session to further ensure Floridians have confidence in our election systems.
Florida is in a better place today because of our governor, but his work isn't finished. With an election coming up this November, I know that with your support, together we can continue building upon the rock of freedom Florida has become.
Get ready, Florida - ** _Governor DeSantis has only just begun to fight for you._**

Casey DeSantis

subject: Wild

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Yesterday, I watched Senator Kyrsten Sinema of Arizona give a speech on
the Senate floor about voting rights.

During this speech, Senator Sinema made it clear that she “strongly
support[s] and will continue to vote for” the voting rights legislation on
the Senate floor right now, while noting in the same breath that “there's
no need for me to restate my support for the 60-vote threshold” —
referencing the filibuster.

Which is it? Because you can’t have it both ways. It’s either the
filibuster, or our Democracy.

Politicians like Sinema and Rand Paul have made it clear that they
couldn't care less about our needs: they will continue using the
filibuster to block all the urgent policies our communities need if it
means pleasing their corporate donors.

What’s happening right now is an urgent reminder of why we’re rising up
this year to replace Rand Paul and expand our Democratic majority in the
Senate.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14592?refcode=em20220114-1451&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=1451%2E346206%2ExGlnnc ]Peter, we
can’t afford to have senators like Kyrsten Sinema, who refuse to stand up
to the Jim Crow filibuster. It’s time for better leadership in the Senate,
and I’d be honored to represent Kentucky in the Senate with your support.
Can you please chip in $5 today to our campaign?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14592?refcode=em20220114-1451&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=1451%2E346206%2ExGlnnc ]Contribute $5

It is so wild that the filibuster is being used to block
everything,
Peter. And I do mean everything
— from voting rights legislation, to codifying Roe v. Wade, to the Build
Back Better Act.

My Grandad didn’t guess the number of beans in a jar for the Senate to sit
on its hands while democracy is hanging in the balance. Voting rights are
not partisan, they’re central to everything. There is no time for excuses.
The time to act is right now.

But our lawmakers in Washington can’t seem to get anything done. We have
control of the White House and Congress; there shouldn’t even be a debate.

It’s beyond time to end it.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14592?refcode=em20220114-1451&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1451%2E346206%2ExGlnnc ]Peter,
when I am elected to the Senate (with
your help!), you will never have to question if I’ll vote to protect
voting rights. I always will. Because voting rights are not partisan;
they’re central to everything — and we need to act. Can I count on you to
chip in?

Thank you,

Charles

name: Rob Secaur
subject: Weekly Update from the Campaign Trail
body:
Jane Timken for Ohio Update [](https://) Dear Peter, This week Jane continued to crisscross the state, put in the work to earn Ohioans' votes, and kept up her momentum as the genuine America First candidate for U.S. Senate. Every day more and more Ohio primary voters are seeing what we’ve known for a long time: Jane Timken is the best candidate to represent Ohio in the U.S. Senate. I hope you’ll take a few minutes to learn more. **Mandel-Aligned Group Confirms Jane's Surge in the Polls** On Monday, Josh Mandel’s own, out-of-state, supporters confirmed what we all know – Josh Mandel is hemorrhaging support while Jane Timken is surging as the fresh leader, clear alternative, and genuine America First candidate that Ohio Republican Primary voters want. While Jane Timken was building Ohio into a conservative stronghold, advancing the America First agenda, fighting the Democrats’ sham impeachments and delivering Ohio for President Trump, Josh Mandel was nowhere to be found. Now, Jane Timken is surging because voters know she is the true America First candidate, who has always had President Trump’s back and who won’t quit when the fighting gets tough. **From The Trail** On Tuesday, Jane was thrilled to join President Trump in support of Congresswoman and GOP Conference Chair Elise Stefanik. Rep. Stefanik is leading the fight to save our country and usher in a red wave in November. We are honored to have her support and endorsement! [](http://links.janetimkenforohio.com/u/click?_t=d33702f99bd24ab29d9d703faac4f8a3&_m=32fa51ae965e4574a369f1b7823df412&_e=bZ9IqSwi6P9HxmOXugl2fbxSkNqXV8_XKLSJmIIHEdMcbZFMQ4Pqq9TPZfe6ZG9nRJjG50jhwP1E-PtozxORBJRhQc0VfSsOPfKeLktLAW7fjaQTz75byj9snyY_0l4fEQG8CDkftkW0hygjS9Yac8W_ekoU83BG0qb6fAWDiAAhTGxCZ3JLG-zBhzJ6yE9vlVq4Cq5kjwG7aRQI14oe1W7ghpoXH3gPUuMppA1QUQUls6GnJ3Lggg_lsraxZB8mRYGgKEK9y4SGqCSfUhmxZj9nbz47CrPJ3Kb3cT4U5Vk-giNTPY37bfGb-OTyPFrDp3EoV_D8sRdx-fyMaIgMEg%3D%3D) On Thursday, Jane visited the Women’s Care Center in Franklin County. They are doing incredible pro-life work in Central Ohio to support and empower women, babies, and families. One of nine babies born in Franklin County starts at Women’s Care and 90% of the women they see choose LIFE! In the U.S. Senate, Jane will always be a partner for the pro-life movement. [](http://links.janetimkenforohio.com/u/click?_t=d33702f99bd24ab29d9d703faac4f8a3&_m=32fa51ae965e4574a369f1b7823df412&_e=bZ9IqSwi6P9HxmOXugl2fco9EJU-M1ATt3naRqNSWj6ZfxrzgIUFwwGL9qDCvDjrmMXWxJ1oeOLMgmuqicgXDZgTOCBp2qLB9lGsC6IzOj4Rl8hcC0MBg1uHCxuF17z_-9PW6LwFgj9l8h_X84DBKvUkAJPB8mASgWIptilHCgLdD-rSKy5Kh6cduOBQhZlNKLxHPdRO2Xd7FubyO_kkBOvWQgCBhmyS1mTRQtdbjCimEUtZcwSu8P99ydaH7Q1yFQ-mLooB9w4yBdvGQuFNfutsO6MPtfwt1_xL7EJ-UNcajnK-Y5-kQ26rfHjoF_fU-QRQm5MYxjqOKDYhCqW7-g%3D%3D) On Thursday night, the campaign kicked off our Parents for Jane coalition with over 150 Ohio moms, dads, and kids. Democrats have waged a war on parents and kids by keeping schools closed, pushing CRT, and labeling parents “domestic terrorists”. Jane was thrilled to be joined by these parents as we fight back! **The Best Grassroots Operation in the Country** I am incredibly proud of our field team and the hundreds of volunteers and interns across the state. They truly are the best grassroots operation in the country and this week we hit a big milestone that proves their hard work and dedication are paying off in big ways. On Wednesday, Jane became the only candidate to officially file for U.S. Senate to date. With over 2,800 signatures **from all 88 counties** , our overwhelming grassroots support was on full display. We couldn’t have done it without our Timken County Chairs in all 88 counties, over 175 endorsements from Ohio conservative leaders, and our fantastic volunteers and interns who have already made more than one million voter contacts. I hope everyone has a great weekend. Sincerely, Rob Secaur Campaign Manager Jane Timken for Ohio Don't want to receive our emails anymore? clean_body: Career politicians and Washington elites fail to solve problems. Please see a note from one of our sponsors. If you would like to unsubscribe visit this Peter, We elect our representatives and senators to solve problems and fight for our values – but very little of that is currently taking place in Washington. The greatest example of that is how politicized COVID has become. Instead of working together to find solutions, career politicians made every COVID-related decision political. They sowed seeds of doubt in the vaccine but then received the same vaccine they claimed to be skeptical of. They turned lockdowns and mandates into a Right vs. Left issue when really it’s about freedom vs. tyranny. And they turned friends and family against one another. But Americans are tired of the fighting, Peter. We’re going into year three of the pandemic and we need our leaders to address this crisis. COVID has impacted our economy, national security, supply chains, and education system. The pandemic has upended every aspect of our lives – and there’s no sign of improvement. It’s time for political outsiders to enter the arena and solve the problems career politicians refuse to address. That’s why I’m reaching out to you, Peter. My name is Marjorie K. Eastman. I’m a veteran, military wife, mother, and businesswoman – and I’m running to represent North Carolina in the U.S. Senate. When I look at the direction our country is heading in, I’m worried. I’m concerned about career politicians’ inability to govern and protect our freedoms. When I joined the Army as an Intelligence Officer and Commander, I took an oath to protect and defend those freedoms. That’s what I’ve always done – and will continue to do in the U.S. Senate. I bring something unique to this race, Peter. I’m the only combat veteran and conservative outsider. I know what it means to go to war, to put your life on the line for your country. I’ve seen first-hand what freedom trulycosts – and that’s something that can’t be bought. In the days and weeks after 9/11, I was like so many other Americans. I felt compelled to serve my country, and I have – through 10 years of intelligence service and two deployments. When I returned home, I faced a personal battle: my son was diagnosed with cancer. I quickly transitioned back into mom mode. My husband and I prayed every day, and eventually, my son beat his diagnosis. I’ve stood by my husband and supported his military career while also working in the private and non-profit sector, all with their own unique challenges. All of these battles led me to this mission today. _Image from History_
The Supreme Court delivered a win for our basic constitutional rights this week. Thursday afternoon, six Supreme Court Justices [struck down](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=a10def4b623f4e929d3617b10bcb9e31&_e=rbFrEsiOyUCuWe4vqzVq56BDPaI0ApshzSQmoihUGiKmsH_94RkWtWw5aXraJK00cwiL3LNukclzUAhlPbxD0U46QfOTlBzPZiOwqURte20ugogqxil8fksLLecm2zH7dVAJ4c5T76wNcAuO76fKY6VO1hIPOJT-HW8KpfTxJZvfOUp2DBQ8biG23Zq6p7NTQhJ3BQqkVbKYtAZAVl3d2EAw_kN7jW8QQ4NUNPaUL2NLFwD0YWiGRWgxwk_K49OkcLXFaRTH93m9uI1Ns1QVA9_1JqXogUzox7--ZpflmC3kO7gy_CKtpXqsmkTdwqZGOYdEPcj7zsTAFTr24BYoQXCoNM4llVitP-z7pMmdClE%3D) President Joe Biden’s federal vaccine mandate on companies with 100 employees or more.

I have long been opposed to vaccine mandates and other draconian COVID-19 measures. Vaccine mandates violate people’s privacy, their freedom, and their right to make personal decisions about their lives. The mandate would have given the federal government unprecedented power to control our most personal choices.

I am so grateful to live in a sane state like Tennessee where our state lawmakers are determined to keep our businesses open, keep our kids in school, and keep the government out of our lives. As I look around the country, I see blue states implementing vaccine mandates, vaccine passports, and school closures that are hurting families, businesses, and kids.

I’m also grateful to live in the United States, where our system of checks and balances protects its citizens from an overzealous, power-hungry federal government.
|
